ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 2-1 in the area bound by:

West Polk Street; the west line of the vacated South Washtenaw Avenue where no
street exists; the alley (and vacated alley) next south of and parallel to West Polk Street;
and a line 52.64 feet west of and parallel to the vacated South Washtenaw Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Alderman, 28'" Ward

Common Address:
2701-2703 W. Polk Street
